The itinerary

One weekend.
Many memories.

Save the dates, choose your moments, and leave room for the unexpected.

Thursday

July 15, 2027

  • 3:00–6:00 PMWelcome & RegistrationPick up your official reunion gift bag and materials. Hospitality suite with open bar and appetizers.
  • 6:00–8:00 PMIcebreaker Welcome Reception & Casual DinnerCasual dinner buffet, family introductions, a slideshow of past reunions, and plenty of time to reconnect.
  • 8:00 PM–lateRooftops & Local EntertainmentStart at Electric Moon Skytop Lounge overlooking the river, then make our way down River Street. Myrtle & Rose, the Bohemian rooftop, the JW Marriott pool lounge, and Wet Willie’s are all close by.
Friday

July 16, 2027

  • 8:00–9:30 AMFamily BreakfastBreakfast at Turbine Market + Cafe at the JW Marriott.
  • 10:00 AM–1:00 PMOld Town Trolley ToursAfrican American history tour, River Street, Savannah squares, the Civil Rights Museum, and Weeping Time Marker.
  • 1:00–2:30 PMLunchTogether at the hotel before the afternoon opens up.
  • 3:00–5:30 PMFree TimeThe rooftop pool, shopping, the hotel, riverfront views, and Historic Downtown Savannah at your own pace.
  • 5:30–6:30 PMHappy Hour at Myrtle & RoseGather and get ready for the all-white dinner and cruise.
  • 6:30 PMTravel to River Street DockThe whole group makes its way down by golf cart, hotel car, or on foot.
  • 7:00–9:00 PMUninhibited White: An All-White Dinner & CruiseBoard the Georgia Queen for dinner, entertainment, and Savannah by night. All-white attire.
  • 10:00 PM–lateRiver Street After-HoursExplore Savannah hotspots and make new memories together.
Saturday

July 17, 2027

  • MorningFamily BreakfastStart the day together at the JW Marriott.
  • 10:30 AM–4:00 PMForsyth Park – Barbecue/Lowcountry BoilKelly Tours takes us to Forsyth Park. Wear your official reunion shirt. Barbecue and Lowcountry boil, games and contests, the 1st Annual McAlpine Family Reunion Spades and Domino Tournaments, life-sized Jenga, and our group photo at the fountain.
  • 5:00–5:30 PMCommittee MeetingPlanning for McAlpine Family Reunion 2029, in the hospitality suite.
  • 5:30–7:00 PMRest & PrepA short break before the evening.
  • 7:00 PM–lateSomething for EveryoneRiver Street for seniors, City Market and River Street for young adults, and video-game sessions for children in the social media suite next to the hospitality suite.
  • 10:00 PM–lateCity Market & Savannah NightlifeHotel car service to City Market to club and bar hop through the nightlife district, with live local jazz for those who want it.
Sunday

July 18, 2027

  • 9:00–11:00 AMFarewell Prayer Breakfast & A.M.E. Zion ChurchClosing remarks and gratitude, then over to one of the country’s oldest Black churches — a chance to give thanks, share memories, and celebrate the family bond that brings us together.
  • 11:00 AM–12:00 PMCheckout & Departure PlanningHugs, goodbyes, and the beginning of our plans for 2029.

Fees cover the weekend's organized events. Rooms are booked separately with the hotel.

Getting there

Savannah/Hilton Head International (SAV) is about twenty minutes from the riverfront. The hotel sits in Historic Downtown, so most of the weekend is walkable once you arrive.

July in Savannah is hot and humid. Bring light clothes, walking shoes for cobblestone, and something white for Friday's cruise.

A note on the fees

We've planned a very special weekend for everyone. As a McAlpine family member, we're asking that you make preparations to afford these fees. We appreciate that everyone has different buying power, but we believe that buy-in by all of us will continue to make the family reunion a must-attend family event.

We'll provide the payment schedule for those who would like to make contributions over time.

Payment schedule coming soon

No refunds

We won't be offering a refund policy — administering one would be too cumbersome. We will use your partial payments to the benefit of our other family members attending the 2027 Family Reunion. Any overpayments will be rolled forward to the 2029 planning committee.

Questions

Good to know

What does the reunion cost?

For the full weekend, $250 per adult and $125 per child. For a partial weekend, $150 per adult and $100 per child. Travel and your hotel room are separate — the room rate is $249 per night at the JW Marriott.

Where is everyone staying?

The JW Marriott Savannah Plant Riverside District, on the riverfront in Historic Downtown. Two room types are set aside: two queens, or one king.

Is there a dress code?

Friday evening is Uninhibited White: An All-White Dinner & Cruise — the event aboard the Georgia Queen calls for all-white attire. Everything else across the weekend is casual.

What is there for the children?

Saturday at Forsyth Park is built for them: games, contests, life-sized Jenga, Spades and Dominoes, and the group photo at the fountain. Saturday evening includes video-game sessions for children.

What about our seniors?

Thursday opens with a hospitality suite and a seated welcome reception. Saturday evening has a River Street plan for seniors specifically, and Sunday closes with the farewell prayer breakfast and a visit to A.M.E. Zion Church.

Can I pay in installments?

Yes. A payment schedule is being put together for anyone who would rather contribute over time. It will be posted here once it's ready.

What is the refund policy?

There isn't one. Administering refunds would be too cumbersome, so fees are non-refundable. Partial payments go toward the weekend for other family members attending in 2027, and any overpayments roll forward to the 2029 planning committee.

How do I pay and book my room?

The hotel link below is live now. Payment details and the family itinerary app are both coming soon — check back, and they'll be linked from the section below.
